grammar.title: Prepositions of Transport: 'En' and 'A'
grammar.explanation:
In Spanish, use 'en' with most forms of transportation:

• Viajar en tren/autobús/avión/taxi - To travel by train/bus/plane/taxi
• Ir en coche/bicicleta/metro - To go by car/bicycle/subway

Use 'a' only with 'a pie' (on foot): Voy a pie al trabajo. (I walk to work.)

Useful travel expressions:
• billete de ida - one-way ticket
• billete de ida y vuelta - round-trip ticket
• ¿A qué hora sale/llega...? - What time does ... leave/arrive?
• El vuelo sale a las... - The flight leaves at...
